pointerAudit.population: Every pointer joined to a published, unexpired generation at the server snapshot time.

durableAudit.episodeCohort: Retained episodes created in the fixed window; all their retained facts and replay receipts at the snapshot.
durableAudit.factReceiptWindow: All retained facts received in the fixed window, including older episodes.
durableAudit.replayObservationWindow: All retained replay receipts observed in the fixed window, including older episodes.
durableAudit.finalizedOutcomeCheck: Latest active-watch-proxy-v1 outcome revision has matching fact watermark and episode generation; queued updates are reported separately.

http.source: Railway httpLogs on the primary Web deployment
http.publishedIdentity: Only SHA-256 of sorted request-ID set

deploymentLogs.source: Railway deployment logs; unfiltered input preserves structured JSON runtime entries
deploymentLogs.output: Allowlisted aggregate fields; raw logs remain private

durableDeliveryAudit.population: Recommendation requests created and evidence audits occurred in the fixed window; aggregated by purpose/state/result/reason only.
